headline: Argentine Stocks Drop for Fifth Day as S&P Merval Tumbles 10%
summary: Argentine stocks fell for five consecutive sessions, with the S&P Merval dropping 10% and country risk approaching 800 basis points amid a global tech rout and an 18% slide in Brazilian equities. The BCRA bought $143 million.
why: Argentine sovereign spreads and local equities reflect investor confidence in fiscal stabilization and foreign reserve accumulation.

impacts.name: S&P Merval
impacts.why: The Merval index plunged 10% across five consecutive declining sessions.
